title: products api should list and search products correctly
description: Verify that the Products API endpoints correctly list all products and support search functionality with appropriate filters, returning HTTP 200 status and accurate product data.

title: authentication api should handle user registration and login securely
description: Test the Authentication API for user registration and login flows using JWT and social login, ensuring secure token issuance and profile retrieval with proper validation and error handling.

title: orders api should create and update orders with correct calculations
description: Validate the Orders API for order creation, ensuring subtotal, shipping, and discounts are calculated correctly, and test order status updates including secure webhook callbacks with HMAC signature validation.
